scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@asrjs/speech-recognition-react && npm run build --workspace=@asrjs/speech-recognition-svelte && npm run build --workspace=@asrjs/speech-recognition-vue
scripts.build:examples: vite build --config vite.react.config.ts && vite build --config vite.svelte.config.ts && vite build --config vite.vue.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:packages && npm run build:examples
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.react-example.json --noEmit && svelte-check --workspace examples/svelte --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && vue-tsc -p examples/vue/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build:suite: npm run build:core && npm run build:packages && node scripts/build-suite.mjs --build-frameworks
